jobs.title: Marketing & Brand Strategist
jobs.description:
Marketing \& Brand Strategist

The Opportunity

We are seeking an **experienced, expert\-level Marketing \& Brand Strategist** to work directly with the Founder/CEO in developing and executing marketing, brand, content, and growth strategies across a portfolio of businesses in healthcare, mental health, insurance, financial services, education, entrepreneurship, and personal development.

This is **not an entry\-level marketing or social media position.**

We are looking for someone who understands how to take a business objective and translate it into a compelling **marketing strategy, brand position, campaign, content plan, and lead\-generation strategy that produces measurable growth.**

The ideal candidate combines high\-level strategic thinking with strong creative execution. You should be able to develop the strategy, shape the messaging, create or direct the visuals, leverage AI, launch campaigns, and analyze what is actually producing results.

What You'll Own

**Marketing \& Growth Strategy**

* Develop and execute marketing and brand strategies across multiple businesses
* Translate business goals into campaigns that generate awareness, qualified leads, appointments, enrollments, and customers
* Develop campaign concepts, messaging, positioning, offers, and calls\-to\-action
* Track and optimize performance based on meaningful business results—not simply likes and impressions

**Brand \& Creative Direction**

* Create and strengthen distinctive brand identities across multiple companies
* Develop or direct high\-quality graphics, advertisements, campaign creative, and digital assets
* Maintain consistency in brand voice, messaging, aesthetics, and visual presentation
* Bring a sophisticated understanding of design and what makes brands current, credible, and compelling

**Content \& Social Media**

* Develop content and social strategies across Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, LinkedIn, YouTube, and emerging platforms
* Build strategic content calendars around business objectives
* Develop content concepts, hooks, scripts, storytelling, and campaigns
* Help plan, direct, record, and edit short\-form and long\-form content
* Identify trends and opportunities relevant to each brand and audience

**AI\-Powered Marketing**

* Effectively utilize current AI tools for marketing strategy, research, ideation, copywriting, design, video, content creation, automation, and campaign optimization
* Identify opportunities to use AI to increase the speed, quality, efficiency, and scalability of marketing
* Stay current with emerging AI, marketing, social media, and creative technologies

Required Experience \& Skills

* **4\+ years of demonstrated experience** in marketing strategy, brand strategy, digital marketing, social media, creative strategy, or a related discipline — or an exceptional portfolio demonstrating comparable expertise
* Proven ability to create campaigns that produce measurable engagement, qualified leads, customer/client acquisition, or revenue growth
* **Strong graphic design, visual branding, and aesthetic skills — required**
* Advanced proficiency with Canva, Adobe Creative Suite, or comparable professional creative tools
* Demonstrated experience using **AI tools in real\-world marketing and creative workflows**
* Strong understanding of digital marketing, social media, content strategy, audience development, and lead generation
* Deep knowledge of current social platforms, short\-form video, digital trends, and evolving audience behavior
* Ability to develop brand positioning, messaging, campaign concepts, and creative direction
* Strong portfolio demonstrating both **strategic thinking and creative execution**
* Ability to independently manage multiple brands, campaigns, priorities, and deadlines

Experience with paid advertising, CRM/funnel platforms such as GoHighLevel, email/SMS marketing, landing pages, marketing automation, photography/videography, or working directly with founders and growing businesses is a plus.

What Success Looks Like

Within the first 90 days, this individual should be able to understand the positioning and audiences of each brand; establish stronger marketing, content, and brand strategies; take ownership of campaign planning and creative execution; and lead campaigns from **strategy → creative → launch → lead generation → analysis and optimization.**

Success will ultimately be measured by improvements in **brand quality, engagement, qualified leads, inquiries, appointments, enrollments, client/customer acquisition, and business growth.**

Schedule \& Compensation

**20–25 hours per week to start**, with the opportunity to transition into a full\-time leadership position within approximately **60–90 days** based on performance, fit, and organizational needs.

**Compensation: $40–$60/hour, depending on experience, portfolio, strategic capabilities, and demonstrated results.**

Local candidates in the **Baton Rouge/Lafayette area are strongly preferred** due to opportunities to participate in content production, campaigns, shoots, and events. Exceptional remote candidates will also be considered.

Please be prepared to discuss **specific campaigns you have developed, the strategy behind them, your personal contribution, the AI and marketing tools you used, and the measurable results produced.**

Pay: $40\.00 \- $60\.00 per hour

Expected hours: 15\.0 – 25\.0 per week

Application Question(s):

* Tell us about a recent marketing campaign you personally helped strategize and execute that produced measurable business results. What was the objective, what strategy did you develop, what did you personally execute, and what were the results?
* Based on what you've learned about this role, how do you believe you would be an asset to our organization? What unique skills, experience, ideas, or perspective would you bring that could help elevate our brands, strengthen our marketing, and contribute to the growth of our companies?

Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Account Director - Agency
jobs.description:
**Account Director – Client \& Affiliate Management**

**Position Summary**

The Account Director is responsible for the strategic leadership, growth, and overall performance of assigned client accounts, while also overseeing the affiliate and media partner relationships that support client delivery.

This role serves as a senior point of contact for clients and is accountable for translating client objectives into actionable performance strategies, coordinating internal teams and external partners, monitoring campaign and lead performance, and ensuring commitments related to volume, quality, cost, and service are achieved.

The Account Director operates as both a client advocate and business owner, balancing client expectations with campaign performance, partner capabilities, profitability, and the company’s broader strategic objectives.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Client Relationship \& Account Leadership**

* Serve as the senior day\-to\-day relationship owner for assigned client accounts.
* Build trusted relationships with client stakeholders and develop a strong understanding of their business objectives, enrollment goals, target audiences, performance expectations, and operational requirements.
* Lead regular client meetings, business reviews, campaign performance discussions, and strategic planning sessions.
* Translate client objectives into clear priorities and execution plans for internal teams and external partners.
* Proactively identify performance concerns, emerging risks, and opportunities and provide clients with clear recommendations and solutions.
* Manage client expectations regarding lead volume, quality, cost, pacing, targeting, and campaign performance.
* Ensure client questions, issues, and escalations are addressed promptly and appropriately.
* Maintain a strong understanding of contractual commitments, campaign requirements, pricing, budgets, and service expectations.

**Affiliate \& Partner Management**

* Manage relationships with affiliate, publisher, lead\-generation, and other external media partners supporting assigned accounts.
* Communicate campaign requirements, targeting criteria, lead specifications, compliance expectations, pricing, volume goals, and quality standards to partners.
* Evaluate affiliate performance using metrics including lead volume, acceptance rates, rejection rates, cost per lead, cost per acquisition, lead quality, conversion performance, and return on investment.
* Monitor lead delivery and identify trends related to filtered, rejected, returned, duplicate, or otherwise non\-compliant leads.
* Hold partners accountable for agreed\-upon performance, quality, compliance, and delivery standards.
* Work with affiliates to optimize campaigns, improve lead quality, adjust volume, resolve performance concerns, and identify opportunities to scale.
* Recommend increasing, reducing, pausing, or terminating partner allocations based on performance.
* Develop strong relationships with high\-performing partners and identify opportunities to expand productive affiliate relationships.
* Assist with sourcing, evaluating, and onboarding new affiliate and media partners where appropriate.

**Revenue \& Account Growth**

* Own the health, retention, and growth of assigned accounts.
* Identify opportunities to expand existing client relationships through increased volume, additional programs, new campaigns, services, products, or media channels.
* Partner with leadership and Business Development on account expansion opportunities.
* Understand account economics, including revenue, partner costs, pricing, gross margin, and profitability.
* Monitor account and partner performance to ensure delivery models remain financially sustainable.
* Participate in forecasting client revenue, campaign volume, and partner allocations.
* Support renewals, pricing discussions, scope changes, and contract extensions as appropriate.

**Cross\-Functional Leadership**

* Serve as the central point of coordination across Client Success, Media, Operations, Analytics, Creative, Product, and other teams supporting assigned accounts.
* Establish clear priorities, responsibilities, timelines, and expectations for account\-related initiatives.
* Ensure internal teams have the information necessary to execute client requirements effectively.
* Facilitate resolution of issues that cross functional or organizational boundaries.
* Escalate material client, partner, financial, compliance, or performance risks to leadership when appropriate.
* Provide clear and timely communication regarding account performance, changes in client priorities, and emerging risks.

**Compliance \& Lead Quality**

* Ensure affiliates and media partners comply with client requirements, company standards, applicable advertising requirements, and campaign\-specific restrictions.
* Partner with internal Compliance, Operations, and Technology teams to investigate lead\-quality or compliance concerns.
* Monitor patterns in rejected, filtered, returned, or disputed leads and work with appropriate teams to determine root causes.
* Ensure partner remediation plans are established when quality or compliance issues are identified.
* Maintain appropriate documentation of significant client and partner performance issues and agreed\-upon corrective actions.

**Performance Measures**

Success in the role may be measured by:

* Client retention and satisfaction
* Account revenue growth
* Gross margin and account profitability
* Achievement of client volume and pacing objectives
* Lead acceptance and delivery rates
* Lead quality and downstream conversion performance
* Cost per lead / cost per acquisition
* Affiliate performance and partner optimization
* Resolution of client and partner issues
* Forecast accuracy
* Identification and execution of account expansion opportunities
* Compliance with client and company requirements

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related

jobs.description:
**About Tekion:**
-----------------


Positively disrupting an industry that has not seen any innovation in over 50 years, Tekion has challenged the paradigm with the first and fastest cloud\-native automotive platform that includes the revolutionary Automotive Retail Cloud (ARC) for retailers, Automotive Enterprise Cloud (AEC) for manufacturers and other large automotive enterprises and Automotive Partner Cloud (APC) for technology and industry partners. Tekion connects the entire spectrum of the automotive retail ecosystem through one seamless platform. The transformative platform uses cutting\-edge technology, big data, machine learning, and AI to seamlessly bring together OEMs, retailers/dealers and consumers. With its highly configurable integration and greater customer engagement capabilities, Tekion is enabling the best automotive retail experiences ever. Tekion employs close to 3,000 people across North America, Asia and Europe.


**Job Introduction:**
---------------------

  

Tekion is looking for a Brand Manager to own the day\-to\-day brand operations that shape how the world sees us. You will manage brand initiatives, standards, digital asset management, website content, and customer storytelling—ensuring consistency and impact across every touchpoint as the tools, workflows, and channels that support them continue to evolve. You will balance creative direction with process optimization to strengthen Tekion's market identity and drive customer engagement. This is a high\-visibility role at the intersection of brand strategy, content operations, and cross\-functional collaboration.  



**Key Roles and Responsibilities**
----------------------------------


* Collaborates with cross\-functional teams and platforms within marketing and across Tekion including product, product marketing, emerging product, value, sales, and design to deliver cohesive brand experiences
* Identifies opportunities to apply AI tools and agents to marketing and content workflows, improving speed and efficiency across brand operations
* Drives customer story development and maintains existing content assets, ensuring they reflect current product capabilities and brand standards
* Executes, and maintains customer\-facing content across external communications, digital channels, and go\-to\-market materials — ensuring messaging reflects current product capabilities and brand standards
* Owns the digital asset management ecosystem and sales enablement library, organizing and governing resources across platforms to ensure accuracy, version control, and brand consistency
* Conducts market research to understand industry and competitor initiatives and applies insights to optimize brand activities.
* Identifies and implements workflow process optimizations that improve production efficiency, review cycles, and cross\-team coordination.
* Guides creative teams on marketing concepts, content direction, and visual storytelling.
* Champions the brand internally, ensuring cross\-departmental understanding and alignment with brand standards.
* Supports event marketing through content and product messaging guidance, and on\-brand asset delivery
* Manages the flow of product updates into marketing and brand content, streamlining how new capabilities and releases are distributed across marketing assets Leads the development of annual market trend analysis and competitive positioning content that serves as a foundational marketing resource throughout the year

**Basic Qualifications**
------------------------

* Hands\-on experience using AI tools and building AI agents or workflows to streamline content production, marketing operations, or creative processes
* 4\+ years of experience in marketing, content operations, or related roles — with demonstrated ownership of brand programs from strategy through execution.
* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field
* Proven success managing brand campaigns, content programs, and cross\-functional marketing initiatives
* Strong creative judgment and experience producing high\-impact content and messaging
* Excellent communication, organizational, and stakeholder management skills
* Ability to follow established project management processes, track deliverables across workstreams, and meet deadlines in a fast\-paced environment
* Highly organized, adaptable, and collaborative — comfortable navigating shifting priorities, managing multiple stakeholders, incorporating feedback from diverse perspectives, and working cross\-functionally with minimal friction
* Experience in the automotive or dealership technology industry, preferred but not required
* Proficient across core marketing and business tools, including Microsoft Office, Apple/macOS, email platforms (e.g., HubSpot), survey tools (e.g., Microsoft Forms), and collaboration platforms such as SharePoint and Confluence
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with strong attention to detail

**Perks \& Benefits**
---------------------


* Competitive compensation and generous stock options
* 100% employer\-paid top\-of\-the\-line medical, dental and vision coverage
* Great benefits including unlimited PTO, parental leave and free snacks and beverages
* The opportunity to work with some of the brightest minds from Silicon Valley’s most dominant and successful companies
* Be part of an early stage, hyper\-growth start\-up with the opportunity to grow and prosper

* The open and transparent culture that encourages innovation, rewards performance and discourages hierarchy

**Position Title:** Visual Brand Manager

**Status:** Full Time

**FLSA:** Exempt

**Location:**Washington, DC; Remote  

  

**JOB SUMMARY \& KEY PRIORITIES:**


The Visual Brand Manager is a visual storyteller. They will bring thought leadership to how the face of Active Minds is portrayed to external audiences, including youth and young adults, supporters, and the general public. Key platforms in use by this position are Active Minds’ print and electronic collateral, website, email, and social media.


The Visual Brand Manager reports to the Senior Visual Brand Manager, as part of the Marketing and Communications department (MarComm), in addition to collaborating with other staff to express the Active Minds brand.

**ABOUT ACTIVE MINDS**
----------------------


Active Minds is the nation’s leading nonprofit organization supporting mental health awareness and education for young adults. Through our presence in more than 1,000 high school and college campuses, communities, and workplaces, and with a wide\-reaching public audience, Active Minds is creating communities of support and saving lives. Founded in 2003 by Alison Malmon after the tragic suicide of her brother, Brian, Active Minds is dedicated to supporting a new generation in ending the silence,helping to make mental health as highly valued as physical health. We approach our work with a racial equity lens and are committed to the continued process of being and becoming a more anti\-racist and inclusive organization. Through our many programs, we are changing social norms and behaviors related to mental health across the country.

**KEY RESULTS**
---------------

**Brand Representation for Programs, Fundraising \& Events (70%)**

* Drive Active Minds’ visual strategy across all departments, delivering high\-quality brand assets that elevate organization\-wide public representation.
* Represent the Visual Brand team in cross\-functional meetings as assigned to develop and manage visual strategy, scopes, design directions, reviews, and timelines.
* Lead creation of representative graphics and visuals to support online brand display, with expectation of replication to print and event materials (signage, print materials, etc.).
* Lead the integration of Active Minds’ visual brand into the programmatic materials, merchandise/SWAG and advertisements, event collateral, donor appeals, and chapter and partnership activities of Active Minds.
* Provide visual graphics for Active Minds’ blogs, emails, texting, and other communications mechanisms.
* Support the development of templates and other long\-term initiatives to grow the Active Minds Brand in consistent and sustainable ways.
* Lead the collection and archiving of photos and videos across the organization.
* Assist with the development of and updates to Active Minds branding guidelines.
* Review and proof materials, ensuring branding guidelines are followed and materials are completed

**Other duties as assigned (30%)**

* Lead video production oversight in collaboration with CDMO, and/or produce simple video content for use in telling the organization’s story and mission.
* Create or coordinate fast response graphics for use across the organization, including for website pop\-ups, social media, partnership proposals, and more.
* Potential for management of direct reports, interns and external contractors as opportunities arise.
* Support the project intake, capacity evaluation and management of visual design projects
* Propose ways for the design team to improve, taking into consideration budget, capacity, and sustainability conditions.

**About You**
-------------

* A creative design eye and hand, with experience collaborating on design creation across teams.
* Accustomed to working on multiple projects with different deadlines simultaneously.
* Ability to communicate effectively in person, over the phone, and in writing, and with fellow staff members.
* Stickler for details and quality.
* A problem\-solver at heart with a passion for finding sustainable solutions.
* A team player who is willing to give and receive feedback.
* A creative who is willing to actively participate in equal measure to: the development of strategic initiatives, the creation of general design work across platforms and mediums, and the project management tasks of an in\-house team.
* Self\-starter with a positive attitude who enjoys working proactively and thinking creatively.
* Thrives in a high\-paced organization.
* Advocate for social entrepreneurship and a believer in young people making an impact.
* Trusted team\-player who will successfully collaborate across teams and work harmoniously and productively with other members of the design team and the greater MarComm team.


You need to have:

* Degree in Graphic Design (or equivalent work experience, demonstrated through a portfolio).
* 4\+ years of related visual brand and/or graphic design experience.
* Experience in a management role.
* Demonstrated grasp of design concepts, with an emphasis on typography skills.
* Knowledge of and experience in nonprofit marketing and communications efforts.
* Experience with Adobe InDesign, Photoshop, and Illustrator, as well as Canva and other design tools.
* Experience designing both digital and print materials.
* Full digital\-literate, including Microsoft and Google products, and online meeting tools.
* Experience with CRM systems (ex. Salesforce) and other databases a plus.
* Photography, photo, and video editing skills a plus.
* Experience with Figma a plus.

jobs.title: Creative Director
jobs.description:
**The Problem**
---------------


Flock's creative group is expanding as the company raises its standard of visual storytelling and campaign execution across brand, film, and digital experiences. This momentum creates a need for unified creative leadership to turn complex technology and public safety outcomes into compelling, human\-centered narratives. You will own that direction, driving the creative concept, visual identity, and craft bar across design, film, and motion.

**What You'll Own**
-------------------

* Direct integrated campaigns, product launch narratives, and flagship brand films from initial concept through final delivery.
* Define and maintain the visual, cinematic, and editorial standards across design, motion, and video production to build a recognizable creative signature.
* Lead and mentor multidisciplinary craft teams, guiding discipline leads in art direction, storytelling, and creative critique.
* Establish operational systems, including reference libraries, templates, and production guidelines, that elevate quality while improving delivery speed.
* Partner with brand strategy and production leadership to translate executive goals into clear creative briefs and execution plans.

**What This Role is Not**
-------------------------

* This is not a hands\-off review role, you will actively shape concepts, guide edits, direct art execution, and refine details across all mediums.
* This isn't a high\-volume template production management job, your main focus is establishing concept quality and narrative depth.
* This is not an isolated brand strategy position, you will work directly alongside production and cross\-functional teams to ship live campaigns.

**What You Bring**
------------------

* Proven track record leading multidisciplinary creative teams across art direction, design, motion, and cinematic film production.
* Deep portfolio demonstrating high\-craft visual design alongside narrative documentary or high\-paced commercial storytelling.
* Advanced fluency in the complete production lifecycle, including typography, editing pace, color grading, sound design, and finishing standards.
* Experience setting practical brand guidelines, design systems, and creative review frameworks for internal teams and agency partners.
* Ability to direct campaigns that balance emotional human narrative with clear technical product messaging.

**Compensation**
----------------


In this role, you'll receive a starting salary between $200,000 and $250,000 as well as Flock Stock Options. Base salary is determined by job\-related experience, education/training, as well as market indicators. Your recruiter will discuss this in depth with you during our first chat.

**Why Flock**
=============

Every community deserves to be safe. Flock builds the technology that makes that real: last year we supported over 1 million criminal investigations and helped locate more than 10,000 missing people. We're 1,700 people building the impossible with over $1B in funding, and the expectations are high on purpose. If you want a role where the stakes are real and the pace matches, this is it.


Some problems get solved faster in the same room, so we prioritize candidates in Atlanta and Boston. Hub\-based roles mean real in\-person time with your coworkers. Remote roles exist, and when a posting is open to remote work, it says so.


The impossible takes every kind of mind. Flock is an equal opportunity employer, and we know the best solutions come from diverse perspectives, experiences, and skills working together with mutual respect. Everyone is welcome to apply. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, email recruiting@flocksafety.com; your information stays confidential and is used only to arrange the right accommodation for your interviews.


On compensation. We pay fairly for the work. Base salary is determined by job\-related experience, education, training, and market indicators. The range in this posting covers base salary only and doesn't include equity, sales bonus plans where applicable, or benefits. The range may be adjusted over time, and this posting may span more than one career level.


One last thing. All legitimate communication from Flock comes from an email ending in @flocksafety.com or noreply@ashbyhq.com. We never make offers through messaging apps or third parties, and we never request payment or sensitive personal information during hiring. If you encounter suspicious outreach about a Flock role, report it to recruiting@flocksafety.com.

jobs.description:
Sales \- US \- Remote

  


**About the Team**
------------------


OpenAI's Go\-To\-Market team helps organizations understand, adopt, and scale the use of advanced AI across their businesses. Our team brings together Sales, Solutions, Customer Success, Marketing, Partnerships, and other cross\-functional leaders to support customers in deploying AI responsibly and delivering meaningful business outcomes.


**About the Role**
------------------


As an Account Director focused on Media content creation, audience engagement, advertising, personalization, customer experience, employee productivity, and new AI\-powered products and services.


This role combines deep enterprise sales experience, executive relationship management, media industry knowledge, and technical fluency. You will work across complex, highly matrixed organizations to identify strategic opportunities, build alignment with senior decision\-makers, and lead enterprise\-wide adoption of OpenAI's products.


You will own the full customer lifecycle, from strategic account planning and opportunity development through negotiation, deployment, consumption growth, and long\-term expansion. In close partnership with Solutions, Product, Engineering, Research, and other internal teams, you will help shape OpenAI's media go\-to\-market strategy and establish durable relationships with some of the industry's most influential companies.


**In this role, you will:**
---------------------------


* Manage a small portfolio of large, strategic media accounts and develop comprehensive, multiyear account plans.
* Build and maintain executive relationships with C\-level and senior business leaders across technology, digital, editorial, content, advertising, audience development, product, data, and AI.
* Lead complex, enterprise\-wide sales cycles involving multiple stakeholders, business units, procurement teams, legal teams, and technical decision\-makers.
* Identify high\-impact AI opportunities across content workflows, editorial operations, advertising, audience insights, personalization, customer care, enterprise knowledge, software engineering, and employee productivity.
* Help customers develop and commercialize AI\-powered offerings for consumers, advertisers, creators, subscribers, and enterprise partners.
* Partner with Solutions, Product, Engineering, and Research teams to design customer programs, demonstrate business value, and support successful deployment.
* Own revenue and consumption targets adoption.
* Expand OpenAI's presence across brands, subsidiaries, geographies, business units, and strategic initiatives within assigned accounts.
* Navigate customer requirements related to security, privacy, data governance, intellectual property, content rights, and responsible AI deployment.
* Develop executive business cases that connect AI adoption to measurable customer outcomesance, operational efficiency, and content velocity.
* Bring insights from the media market into OpenAI's product roadmap, industry strategy, and account planning.
* Collaborate with Marketing, Communications, Partnerships, Finance, Legal, and Business Operations to advance strategic customer relationships.
* Contribute to the development of a repeatable media sales motion and help build OpenAI's industry presence.

**We're seeking someone with experience including:**
----------------------------------------------------


* 14\+ years of enterprise sales experience selling AI, cloud, SaaS, PaaS, data, advertising technology, or other complex technology solutions to large enterprise customers.
* Demonstrated success managing and expanding relationships with major media, entertainment, publishing, streaming, advertising, or digital content companies.
* A consistent track record of meeting or exceeding annual revenue targets of $2 million or more.
* Experience leading large, complex, multiyear enterprise sales cycles and negotiating strategic commercial agreements.
* Established ability to build trusted relationships with CIOs, CTOs, chief digital officers, chief data and AI officers, chief product officers, content leaders, advertising leaders, and audience or subscription executives.
* Strong understanding of the media industryation, and competitive dynamics.
* Experience developing account strategies across highly matrixed, multinational organizations with multiple brands or business lines.
* Comfort discussing AIs, data security, content workflows, and technical implementation with both executive and technical audiences.
* Strong consultative selling, account planning, negotiation, and forecasting skills.
* A demonstrated ability to translate emerging technology into measurable business outcomes.
* Enthusiasm for helping large organizations deploy AI safely and responsibly at scale.

**You might thrive in this role if you:**
-----------------------------------------


* Enjoy owning a small number of highly strategic, high\-impact accounts.
* Know how to create executive alignment across organizations with competing priorities.
* Can connect long\-term media transformation to immediate, actionable customer opportunities.
* Are energized by building an industry\-specific sales motion in an evolving market.
* Bring equal parts commercial discipline, curiosity, and technical fluency.
* Are passionate about the potential for AI to reshape how media companies create, distribute, monetize, and personalize content.

**About OpenAI**

jobs.title: Senior Partner Account Director - Digital Advertising (Remote - EST/CST)
jobs.description:
**Summary**
-----------


Looking to kick things up a notch? Yelp is seeking a tenacious, sales professional with a proven track record of success in a fast\-paced, high growth company to join Yelp’s newest division, Agency \& Partner Sales.  

This entrepreneurial leader will build relationships with senior executives across the local advertising industry, launch and grow existing relationships, and execute cross\-functional partnerships with direct visibility into Yelp's senior management.  

The primary responsibility of the Senior Partner Account Director is to acquire new business for Yelp by developing relationships with Agencies \& 3rd parties focused on the SMB market. These Agencies partner with Yelp to resell and buy Yelp’s local products.  

The ideal candidate for this position will have the ability to quickly understand the business and demonstrate the value of Yelp’s product offering and partnership program. This position requires a highly motivated and energetic individual who possesses the ability to develop strategic relationships and generate new business. The ideal candidate takes a consultative approach to sales \- understanding agency models and uncovering the needs and decision criteria of your prospects. Above all, you will be responsible for hitting your revenue targets.  

Sound like you? Keep reading.**What you'll do:**
-------------------

* You will establish a collaborative business relationship between Yelp and SMB (primarily local) agencies and their advertisers.
* You will consistently deliver new partner\-driven revenue every quarter, exceeding sales targets.
* You will lead the partnership and deal\-origination process, managing each step from strategy/planning, pipeline development, outreach, implementation, and ongoing growth.
* You will create consultative sales presentations to demonstrate how Yelp’s advertising products can be leveraged to connect with consumers.
* You will represent Yelp as a spokesperson and evangelist at industry events.
* You will contribute to the evolving vision of Yelp's advertising partner program.
* You will develop and manage partner relationships to ensure over\-achievement of assigned goals.
* You will identify new agency partnerships which will meet Yelp partner compliance as needed to meet growth expectations.
* You will map out agency structure and identify key decision makers, budget owners and the agencies’ decision making process.
* You will engage with agencies on an ongoing basis to foster relationships, validate advertisers needs and keep Yelp’s partnership top of mind.
* You will work collaboratively with cross\-functional teams to drive revenue growth with new customers.
* Use Chatbench, Yelp’s internal tool that provides secure access to a number of LLM models, to research, draft proposals, analyze data and overcome objections.
* You will come to work each day with a positive attitude and ready to win.

**What it takes to succeed:**
-----------------------------

  

* You have a minimum 7\+ years of experience in agency \& partnership or channel sales, BD or digital sales role
* You preferably have experience with advertising products, APIs, and channel programs across the industry (e.g. Google, Bing, Facebook)
* You have demonstrated success in hitting sales goals in a previous position
* You have a strong network of tech industry contacts, ranging from startups to established brands.
* You have influential communication skills in all forms: written, presentations, negotiations, and listening.
* You have a passion for Yelp’s product, as well as other consumer internet/mobile products.
* You have a flexible, startup mindset, and ability to operate within a very dynamic, fast\-paced work environment
* You consider yourself to be self\-motivated, a team player and have a strong drive to exceed targets
* You are okay with travel as needed
* You will need access to an individual hardline high\-speed internet connection in your workspace. This job cannot be performed using satellite internet or a mobile hotspot

**What you'll get:**
--------------------

* Effective your first day: Full medical, vision, and dental
* 15 days PTO (accrual begins on date of hire and increases with 2\+ years of tenure thereafter), 12 paid holidays, plus one floating holiday
* Up to 14 weeks of parental leave
* Monthly wellness subsidy
* Work from home reimbursement
* Flexible spending account
* 401(k) retirement savings plan
* Employee stock purchase plan
* The base salary for this role is $110K annually.
* This role is also eligible to earn uncapped quarterly incentive compensation (sales commissions).
* Target annual compensation for this role is $220K, which includes base salary and quarterly incentive compensation assuming minimum performance expectations are met.
* Top performers have the opportunity to significantly exceed target earnings.

jobs.title: Account Director
jobs.description:
The Pathlabs Account Director is directly responsible for developing strategic opportunities into long\-standing, profitable relationships through effective leadership. This position oversees a team of Account Managers, Campaign Analyst Supervisor, Campaign Analysts, and Account Associates and is accountable for the performance, development, and output of the entire team. An excellent Account Director operates from a documented, repeatable operating rhythm rather than reactive firefighting, and is evaluated against four core competencies: Client Leadership, Business Acumen, Team Leadership, and Strategic Thinking. The Account Director maintains close, senior\-level relationships with clients but is not the day\-to\-day point of contact.


Candidates for this position must possess an extensive background in advertising and/or marketing, deep fluency in digital ad buying platforms and advertising metrics, and a demonstrated track record of leading people managers — not just individual contributors. The ideal candidate has served as an Account Director, Group Account Director, Senior Account Manager progressing into a leadership role, Digital Media Director, or similar leadership position at an agency, or in an execution\-focused leadership role at a media\-focused organization. This candidate has led and developed teams and driven measurable, profitable growth within a portfolio of accounts.

**Key Performance Indicators**

* Team KPI Compliance \> 90%
* Team Delivery Compliance \> 98%
* Team Make\-Good Rate \< 0\.3%
* Team Margin

**Responsibilities**
====================

**Client Leadership**
---------------------

* Maintain senior, trust\-based relationships with client leadership; implement and maintain consistent process, scope, and top\-tier service levels
* Act as the key strategist for campaign initiatives and business development pitches, including current\-logo RFPs and proposal development
* Diagnose the real need behind a client request rather than reflexively accommodating it, and design solutions that protect both the client relationship and the team's sustainability
* Proactively identify service gaps, implementing immediate solutions.

**Business Acumen**
-------------------

* Own the retention, growth, and profitability of an assigned portfolio of client accounts
* Identify efficiencies and improve profitability through effective management of media costs, accuracy, automation, and resourcing
* Tie media efforts back to the end client’s business objectives, vs allowing vanity metrics to equate as success
* Deliver structured, proactive updates to VP/leadership on portfolio health

**Team Leadership**
-------------------

* Run regular 1:1s, calibrate each direct report against documented performance standards, and manage the staffing needs of the team – including hiring, discipline, and performance improvement – in partnership with the VP of Media Services.
* Train and develop team members to become independent operators and problem solvers; ensure proper utilization of AI tools, standardized workflows and support systems
* Directly and promptly address performance gaps with documentation; do not let quality issues slide to avoid a difficult conversation
* Provide positive feedback to your direct reports to reinforce the right actions
* Collaborate cross\-functionally with the sales team to identify strategic opportunities, remove challenges, and ensure alignment across our teams

**Strategic Thinking**
----------------------

* Look for the systemic cause behind recurring issues (e.g., a KPI target problem, a capacity problem, a process gap) rather than resolving each instance in isolation
* Dig deep with the team to have a clear understanding of capacity, roadblocks and gaps; ensuring we are understanding root causes first and providing necessary clarity to the team
* Plan roughly 90 days out across the portfolio to catch problems before they surface as client escalations
* Stay abreast of new solutions, technologies, and opportunities in the media space, and collaborate with the product team to influence the product roadmap
* Complete all work on accounts as assigned, and take on other duties as needed to evolve this position.

**Qualifications**
==================

* Demonstrated ability to lead through other managers – not just through individual contributors – with a track record of developing account service and technical team members alike into stronger operators
* Intelligent self\-starter with an analytical orientation, strategic vision, and a strong executional track record at the portfolio level.
* Excellent customer intuition: the ability to anticipate a client's needs and potential issues before the client raises them.
* Genuine commitment to high standards and accountability, paired with the ability to hold direct, honest conversations with employees and clients while still leading with compassion and understanding.
* Ability to balance individual account needs, team capacity, and company\-wide priorities without letting any one dominate.
* Forward\-thinking mindset with a documented habit of proactive planning, not just reactive problem\-solving.
* Strong business acumen that supports and is in line with the long\-term vision of Pathlabs and its profitability.
* Demonstrated fluency in the Four Competencies framework; Client Leadership, Business Acumen, Team Leadership, Strategic Thinking
* Full alignment with Pathlabs's Core Values:
	+ Unforgettable Service
	+ People First
	+ Own It
	+ Master the Craft

**Skills and Requirements**
===========================

* Experience with digital advertising, advertising metrics, ad buying platforms, and DSPs at a portfolio\-management level.
* Proven leadership experience managing people managers (not only individual contributors) – 4\+ years.
* A proven track record of managing and growing a multi\-account client portfolio profitably – 6\+ years.
* Experience in a customer\-facing role within the industry – 8\+ y
